PV Capacity Distribution

Shows how rooftop solar system sizes are distributed across analyzed buildings. Most buildings fall into the smaller-capacity range, while a small number of large roofs contribute disproportionately.

Cumulative Energy Contribution

Shows how quickly total neighborhood solar potential accumulates as buildings are ranked from highest to lowest output.

Capacity Categories

Groups buildings into buckets to reveal whether solar potential is broadly distributed or concentrated among a few large properties.

Why this matters

PV capacity estimates the maximum installed solar size possible on rooftops. Annual generation estimates yearly electricity production under average weather conditions. The cumulative curve illustrates how much of the neighborhood's solar potential comes from its highest-producing buildings.
